project_name.justification: The text announces an agreement to acquire the Suni Iron Ore Project: "signed an agreement to acquire the Suni Iron Ore Project in Ontario Canada."

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified at the beginning of the press release: "GreenBank Capital (CSE:GBC)(OTC PINK:GRNBF)(FRA:2TL) ("GreenBank" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has signed an agreement to acquire the Suni Iron Ore Project..."

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the buyer, Greenbank, is identified in a quote: "Vilhjalmur Thor Vilhjalmsson, the CEO and Chairman of Greenbank, had this to say..."

interest_acquired_percent.justification: Greenbank is acquiring 100% of the holding company for the project: "signed an agreement to acquire 100% of the issued shares ("the Purchased Shares") in 1500597402 Ontario Inc., which holds the Suni Iron Ore project in Ontario Canada."

primary_commodity.justification: The project is explicitly identified as an iron ore project: "signed an agreement to acquire the Suni Iron Ore Project in Ontario Canada."

verified_article_link.justification: The article is about the acquisition of the Suni project by Greenbank Capital. The source link is provided at the end of the article text: "View source version on accesswire.com: https://www.accesswire.com/793532/strategy-update-acquisition-and-agm-results"

currency.justification: The purchase price is stated in Canadian Dollars: "The aggregate purchase price (the "Purchase Price") for the Purchased Shares is ONE HUNDRED FIFTY THOUSAND Canadian Dollars (Cdn$150,000,)"

cash_payments_raw.justification: The payment is made via shares, not cash. Per the financial data extraction hierarchy, this field is null because `amount_of_shares_issued` and `issued_share_price` are populated.

share_payments_raw.justification: Per the financial data extraction hierarchy, this field is null because `amount_of_shares_issued` and `issued_share_price` are populated.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: Per the financial data extraction hierarchy, this field is null because higher priority fields (`amount_of_shares_issued` and `issued_share_price`) are populated.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The payment consists of a total of 3 million shares, issued in two tranches: "by the issuance of a total of 3 million Common Shares in the capital of the Purchaser to the two sellers... (a) 1,500,000 Common Shares on closing; and (b) 1,500,000 Common Shares on the earlier of the date on which the Purchaser obtains an updated NI 43-101 Technical Report and 9th October 2024"

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The announcement does not mention any exploration commitment in terms of drilling meters.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The announcement does not mention any monetary exploration commitment.
